random_forest.verdict: third non-recovery; forward reproducibility fixed, historical value not recovered

canonical_form_selection.form: ratios of SORTED edge lengths; population standard deviations for dispersion features
canonical_form_selection.justification: a scale-free descriptor must be invariant to axis labelling — a property of the feature
canonical_form_selection.NOT_blinded: the variant grid had already computed and printed all 12 rankings when this form was selected, with both sorted variants tied top at 188/210. An earlier version of the finding claimed the choice was fixed before the grid was read; that was false and is corrected. The invariance argument stands independently, but the selection was not blinded and is not described as such.

partition_canonical.rule: 2% length / 1 degree angle; monoclinic branch requires beta genuinely non-90

predicate_code.rule: _metric_system at tol=2e-2 (length, relative) and 1.0 degree (angle), then _box_sufficient: hexagonal_or_trigonal is always ambiguous; trigonal_rhombohedral is sufficient only if truth is trigonal; otherwise sufficient iff the metric class equals the true system
predicate_code.reference_implementation: scripts/run_e05_oracle.py::_metric_system/_box_sufficient, BUT that file hardcodes tol=1e-2 and 0.5 degrees, which gives 144/66. The canonical partition needs 2e-2 and 1.0.
predicate_code.note: I briefly recorded this as a fourth non-recovery after running the reference file at ITS default tolerance rather than the canonical one. That was my error, not a record defect: at the canonical tolerance the split and all five composition classes reproduce exactly. The retracted claim is noted here so the correction is visible rather than silent.
